scripts.lint:all: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run type-check
scripts.db:reset: npx supabase db reset && docker exec supabase_db_workout-app psql -U postgres -d postgres -c "NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';" && echo PostgREST schema reloaded!
scripts.db:use-prod: copy .env.prod .env && echo Usando credenciais de PRODUCAO
scripts.db:use-local: copy .env.local .env && echo Configurado para Supabase LOCAL
scripts.seed:workouts: docker exec -i supabase_db_workout-app psql -U postgres -d postgres < supabase/seed-workouts.sql && echo Treinos populados!
scripts.seed:all: npm run seed:users && timeout /t 2 /nobreak >nul && npm run seed:workouts
